text:
Alex H.: Ran the November traffic rehearsal this morning against prod-like fleet (staging config). posting the quick summary here so we can decide provisioning adjustments.
Maria P.: nice, high level numbers?
Alex H.: sim details: 90m run, peak 9.2k concurrent inference requests, p95 latency target 250ms. workload mix: 60% chat-stream, 30% short-gen, 10% embedding batch.
ops-bot: sim finished: peak_concurrency=9203; avg_gpu_util=78%; max_queue_ms=420; evictions=3
Kevin L.: queue spike 420ms at p95 is concerning. where did the evictions happen?
Alex H.: evictions were in ap-southeast-1 (edge) during a transient network partition to storage. two pods lost KV cache and had to warm, one pod OOM-killed on shard rebalancing.
Priya S.: OOM on shard rebalancing — which model and instance type?
Alex H.: gpt-medium-quant, instance type gpu-v100-8. OOM occurred when we scaled up 3x replicas during peak and each replica tried to load full KV window. we had default cache limits.
Maria P.: okay. immediate mitigation options? increase cache limit? increase prewarm replicas? change autoscale cooldown?
Kevin L.: short term: pin smaller KV window in ap-southeast for the canary hours (reduce from 2048 -> 1024 tokens). also raise autoscale threshold to 60% CPU/gpu util to avoid panic scaling. long term: add shard-aware warmups so new replicas pull condensed cache snapshot rather than full KV.
Priya S.: what about capacity commitments for november week (Nov 20-28)? current reserved commit covers 1.6M GPU-hours; sim projects 2.1M if we keep current batching.
Alex H.: yes that delta is ~31% over commit. two levers: 1) temporary burst capacity (spot + burst pool) for 72h windows, 2) tweak batching to reduce token cost per req (we simulated improved batching -> reduces GPU-hours by ~18%).
Maria P.: cost impact estimates?
Alex H.: burst capacity (spot mix) for that delta ~ $420k extra. batching improvements (software) one-time engineering effort, estimated 2 engineer-weeks and would save ~ $320k per season assuming same traffic profile.
Kevin L.: ops tradeoff: spot introduces preemption risk — need fallback to smaller model variant when preempted. We have that fallback flow but it's not fully automated per-region.
Priya S.: can we automate region fallback within rollout window? e.g., route 20% of backlog to us-west-2 when ap-southeast is degraded.
Alex H.: yes, smart-routing policy exists but needs a policy file edit + canary. I can push a conservative policy today and engage routing oncall.
ops-bot: action logged: /issue create "nov-surge-routing-policy" assigned Alex H.
Maria P.: sequence proposal for the team: (1) push conservative routing policy to shift 10-20% overflow to us-west-2; (2) reduce KV window for ap-southeast during peak; (3) enable spot burst pool with preemption fallback to smaller model; (4) postpone non-critical batch jobs during Nov 20-28 window. agree?
Kevin L.: +1 on sequence. also add a runbook step to monitor 'max_queue_ms' and 'evictions' and trigger manual rollback threshold at >500ms or evictions>5 in 15m.
Priya S.: I'll update the capacity commit spreadsheet to reflect 2.1M projected GPU-hours and mark the 500k-hour delta as 'burst-needed' for finance review.
Alex H.: I'll open two PRs: routing policy and kv-window config. tagging @Maria P. and @Kevin L. for review. ETA for PRs: EOD today.
Maria P.: I'll review and run a focused 30m rehearsal tomorrow at peak hour to validate routing + kv change.
Kevin L.: leaving a note: during rehearsal, collect per-model token batching histograms and gRPC retransmit counts — those did spike in staging earlier.
Priya S.: finance ping: @finance-team FYI we'll likely need a one-off burst budget for Nov surge. Maria, can you add the rough numbers to the request ticket?
Maria P.: yup will do after the rehearsal.
Alex H.: final note: we observed ~12% reduction in headroom when TLS termination CPU load increased on host side — let's add TLS CPU metric to the dashboard so we don't miss host-level bottlenecks.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: "nov-dryrun-check" on 1775070000
Alex H.: thanks all. will post PR links and the rehearsal schedule.
